_comment: Per-term corrections applied to a SPECIFIC (source, id) record, checked before
heslar_map / teater_branch_map resolve the record's list/branch (issue #6,
finding 4 of comment 5395681950; workstream B4 of the post-review plan).
'facet' forces a different facet than the record's own list/branch would give
it. Use this only for a single mis-sorted record inside an otherwise-correct
list -- moving an entire list belongs in heslar_map, an entire TEATER
(sub-)branch in teater_branch_map (which already resolves most-specific-first
along the broader chain, so no per-term override is needed for that case).
'facet' also accepts the reserved value '__exclude__', which drops this one
record from the built vocabulary entirely -- the per-term counterpart of an
'_exclusions' entry, for a single unusable term inside a list worth keeping.
Exclusion is applied before same-label dedup, so a term another (kept) record
also offers survives under that record; only this id goes away.
'sub' overrides the sub-header this record renders under, independently of
'facet'. Without it a record moved by 'facet' keeps the sub-header of the list
it was moved away from -- 'kostel' would read 'Feature / areál aktivity'. Give
the already-rendered Czech label (the heslar_labels value, e.g. 'druh objektu',
not 'objekt_druh'); prefer one the target facet already uses, or the prompt
grows a sub-header with a single term under it. May also supply a sub-header
for a record whose source offers none.
'qualifier_cs' pulls this record OUT of a same-label dedup group into its own
bracketed enum entry '<cs> (<qualifier_cs>)', for a genuine homonym where two
records share a Czech label but denote different things (finding 1 of comment
5395681950; motyc 5439363875: 'Bracketed solution sounds good'). Do NOT add
one on a hunch: most same-label collisions are the same concept, or plain
translation variance, and should just dedup -- vocab_manager's default already
does that, carrying every discarded record's id on the surviving term. Only
add a qualifier once a human has actually confirmed the split (this is
@david-spacil's review per M10, not something to infer from an EN gloss diff).
'same_as' and 'same_as_suppress' correct the composite/component links
(issue #6, O1/F). A composite label 'X/Y' is linked to a standalone 'X' or
'Y' automatically, since both are selectable answers for the same line and
an exact-match score would call one of them wrong. 'same_as' adds a link no
label shape implies; 'same_as_suppress' drops one a reviewer judges wrong
-- two senses that merely share a word. Both take a list of {source, id}
and are declared from ONE side only: a link is symmetric, so stating it
twice would just be two places to forget. Neither changes what the prompt
offers; both sides stay selectable and the link is scoring-time equivalence.
Every override needs 'reason' and every application is recorded in the
placement audit CSV as 'override:<source>:<id>' so it stays reviewable.
Match on (source, id) only -- never on the bare label, which is exactly the
ambiguity these overrides exist to resolve.

overrides.reason: kostel: AMCR double-registers the term under both areal (HES-000021) and objekt_druh (HES-000465, 'church'/'church'); first-occurrence dedup keeps the lower ident (areal -> Activity Area). Domain review (issue #6, comment 5395681950) confirms Feature; the objection was withdrawn as a dedup artifact, not a taxonomy dispute (comment 5426046951).
kaple: same AMCR double-registration shape as kostel (areal HES-000020 / objekt_druh HES-000496, 'chapel'/'chapel'). Comment 5395681950.
mlýn: same AMCR double-registration shape as kostel (areal HES-000028 / objekt_druh HES-000480, 'mill'/'mill'). Comment 5395681950.
cesta: same AMCR double-registration shape as kostel (areal HES-000048 / objekt_druh HES-000520). Comment 5395681950.

zahrada: dedup currently keeps the AMCR objekt_druh record (Feature) over TEATER's 'areál zemědělské výroby' sub-branch (id 1298, branch 1267 -> Activity Area). Domain review (comment 5395681950) assigns Activity Area -- the 'building vs. ground' correction, opposite direction from kostel/kaple/mlýn/cesta.

přírodní útvar: resolves to Feature via objekt_druh (AMCR) and branch 1481 (TEATER) alike; domain review (comment 5395681950) assigns Finds Context instead -- a natural feature is the context a find was recovered from, not a built feature.

zámek: three records share this label -- AMCR HES-000817 (predmet_druh, 'lock') and TEATER 2358 (branch 1788, 'lock') mean the same thing and dedup normally; TEATER 1439 (branch 1267, 'châteaux') is a genuine homonym, not translation variance. motyc approved the bracketed-qualifier convention for exactly this case (comment 5439363875); 'sídlo elity' is TEATER's own sub-branch label for the châteaux sense.
